run_download_demo_data: run the download script with --demo_data to fetch the financial phrasebank training data
run_download_checkpoints: run the download script with --checkpoints to download all trained model checkpoints
run_download_specific_checkpoint: run the download script with --checkpoints --method --setting to download a specific model checkpoint
run_download_all_checkpoints: run the download script with --checkpoints --setting all --method all to download every checkpoint
run_download_with_custom_dirs: run the download script with --data_dir and --checkpoint_dir to specify custom output directories
